content.short: Cornucopias is a Cardano metaverse MMORPG built with Unreal Engine, digital land, and play-and-earn systems.
content.description: Cornucopias is a Cardano-linked metaverse MMORPG built with Unreal Engine and designed for multi-platform play. The game world combines exploration, digital land, vehicles, collectibles, storytelling, and player-driven economic activity. Its model includes play-and-earn, build-and-earn, learn-and-earn, and host-and-earn loops supported by the COPI utility token. Cornucopias aims to give players ownership and agency inside a large virtual world where gameplay, creativity, and blockchain assets work together.
